findings.claim_text: In October 2025 LinkedIn sued ProAPIs, alleging an "industrial-scale" scheme of fake accounts that scraped data visible only to logged-in members and sold access for up to $15,000 a month.
findings.contradicting_quote: Search summary only (page body did not load): consent judgment with permanent injunction reportedly signed 16 Sept 2026.

findings.claim_text: Brokers had to start processing requests in August 2026, and a secondary summary reports they must pull requests at least every 45 days and face $200 per deletion request per day for non-compliance.
The tweet says "a few cents", while the published price per credit is 15 to 20 cents, and the page does not state how many credits a person lookup consumes.
